rubriker.title: European Club Cup: Comfortable wins for the favourites
rubriker._rss_content: The European Club Cup began on Saturday in Budva, Montenegro, with 108 teams competing in the open section and 22 in the women's tournament. The leading clubs secured comfortable victories, although there were a couple of individual upsets. Defending champions SuperChess Romania and Monte-Carlo both started with wins, while Novy Bor's Nils Grandelius suffered a surprising defeat against Serbian CM Slobodan Filipovic. The women's competition saw seventh seeds Crvena Zvezda held to a draw. | Pictured: Alkaloid's Arjun Erigaisi | Photo: Mark Livshitz / ECU

rubriker.title: The European Club Cup kicks off in Budva
rubriker._rss_content: From 17 to 23 October, Budva in Montenegro will host the European Club Cup. With over 100 teams competing in the open section and 22 teams in the women's competition, it is a large-scale event. The favourites, in each of the sections, are teams from Türkiye and Monaco. The highest-rated players in the field are Nodirbek Abdusattorov, Wei Yi and Anish Giri. | Image: European Chess Union

rubriker.title: US Championships: So comes from behind to beat Robson, becomes sole leader
rubriker._rss_content: Wesley So defeated Ray Robson in round seven of the US Championship to take the sole lead on 5/7, half a point ahead of Fabiano Caruana and Andy Woodward. Awonder Liang suffered his second defeat, as he lost to Grigoriy Oparin. In the women's tournament, Alice Lee and Rachael Li share first place on 5½/7, followed closely by Irina Krush, while Thalia Cervantes suffered her first defeat of the event, against Anna Sargsyan. | Photo: Lennart Ootes / Saint Louis Chess Club

rubriker.title: U.S. Championship: Round 7
rubriker._rss_content: Friday's Round 7 in Saint Louis reshuffled both sections. In the open, Wesley So came back from a worse position to beat Ray Robson and lead alone on 5/7, while Awonder Liang lost in 27 moves to Grigoriy Oparin. In the women's, Rachael Li and Alice Lee both won to lead on 5.5, and overnight co-leader Thalia Cervantes lost to Anna Sargsyan.

rubriker.title: My 70th Memorable Game
rubriker._rss_content: On 17th October 1956, a sensational sacrificial game played in New York City by a 13-year-old chess upstart from Brooklyn shot across the globe. It was a game that literally took the chess world by storm. It contains a stunning sacrificial onslaught and is regarded as one of the most famous games of chess that has ever been played. In the October issue of CHESS magazine John Henderson recalls the game that made 13-year-old Bobby Fischer famous. It was played seventy years ago, today.

rubriker._rss_content: The chess tables of New York are a little quieter this week. The man everyone called "The Doctor," a fixture of the city's street chess for decades, has died.

rubriker.title: Copa Europea de Clubes: Ronda 2
rubriker._rss_content: La Copa Europea de Clubes se celebra del 17 al 23 de octubre en Budva, Montenegro, con la participación de 108 equipos en la sección abierta y 22 equipos en la competición femenina. El torneo, que se disputa a siete rondas, cuenta con varios jugadores de élite, entre ellos Nodirbek Abdusattorov, Wei Yi, Alexandra Goryachkina y Humpy Koneru. | Sigue la competición en directo, con comentarios de expertos, a partir de las 14:00 hora de Madrid (9:00 Buenos Aires, 6:00 Ciudad de México).
